RASC Monday Road Ride

Rochester, MN

RASC Monday Road Ride is a road group ride in Rochester, MN. It meets every Monday, 6:00 pm (summer), starting at Bamber Valley Elementary School. Pace: A/B/C/D speed groups.

About the RASC Monday Road Ride group ride

A club road ride split into four speed groups so there is a place for most riders. Meets at Bamber Valley Elementary on the southwest side. There is also a Wednesday road ride from Bicycle Sports and a Thursday gravel ride. Helmets required.
